Professional Summary
Talent acquisition and HR professional with hands-on experience in recruitment lifecycle, HRIS operations, payroll coordination, and employee onboarding. Skilled in leveraging Workday and Confluence to streamline processes and improve candidate and employee experience. Focused on delivering timely hires and smooth new-hire transitions in fast-paced technology environments.

Technical Skills
Recruitment, Talent Acquisition, Workday, Payroll, Onboarding, Confluence, Git

Work Experience

Talent Acquisition Specialist, Zoho (May 2025 - Present)
- Managed end-to-end recruitment for software and support teams, using Workday to track candidate progress and ensure offer-to-acceptance timelines met hiring targets; reduced average time-to-offer by 18% quarter-over-quarter.
- Coordinated Payroll inputs with finance and HRBP teams, verifying new-hire data and updates in Workday to avoid discrepancies during monthly payroll runs.
- Designed and executed structured onboarding programs using Confluence documentation for new hires, improving first-week task completion rates and early employee satisfaction scores.
- Collaborated with engineering hiring managers to maintain candidate pipelines and utilized Git-hosted repositories for shared interview feedback templates and scorecards.

HR Executive, Infosys (Apr 2024 - Apr 2025)
- Supported recruitment operations for campus and lateral hiring, managing applicant tracking in Workday and scheduling interviews to meet cohort onboarding deadlines.
- Assisted in Payroll data validation and entry, reconciling employee records to minimize payroll exceptions during monthly processing.
- Facilitated onboarding logistics and new-employee orientation sessions, using Confluence pages to centralize resources and checklists for smoother ramp-up.
- Partnered with talent acquisition team to source and screen candidates, leveraging Talent Acquisition best practices to improve offer acceptance rates.
